description: EVNotify is an open-source software project listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Mobility and Transportation", published or maintained by EVNotify (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). allows you to monitor your electric vehicle and let you notify when the specified preset state of charge has been achieved. It can support mobility and transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
